register.productionRisk: Missing browser ESM dependencies can make static HTML look healthy while all interactive runtime behavior is dead.
register.whatItProves: The complete reachable browser module graph is present in the built artifact.
register.whatItDoesNotProve: It does not execute Chromium or prove user journeys.
register.failureHandling: Repair build packaging and rerun full validation.
register.removalConditions: Only after an equal or stronger import-graph/build resolver is admitted.

register.productionRisk: Silent absence of CI. The repo had no workflow at all until 2026-09-04 and nothing was red because nothing ran.
register.whatItProves: CI exists, parses, declares real jobs and steps, is wired to push and pull_request on main, runs validate:all, and never deploys.
register.whatItDoesNotProve: Does not prove branch protection requires the check, nor that the hosted run passes.
register.failureHandling: Restore the workflow. Never satisfy this by weakening the assertion.
register.removalConditions: Only if an equal or stronger CI-existence proof is admitted first.

register.productionRisk: Founders who come through Pitch Lab never reach the master network sheet, so the lead generation engine generates no leads; or a future reader finds the CONTACT_AUTO_CREATE_GUARD, concludes Pitch Lab must never create contacts, and reverses the owner decision of 22 Sep 2026.
register.whatItProves: Drives the real site-form intake client against a stubbed fetch: the door URL and shared-secret header, the lowercased email, the pitch_lab_profile / pitch_lab_share tagging, the submission id that makes a retry idempotent, and that every failure mode (door error, network error, unconfigured, invalid input) returns a status instead of throwing. Also pins that BOTH destinations still run and that the legacy pitch-lab queue guard is untouched.
register.whatItDoesNotProve: Does not prove a deployed door, a live sheet write, or that the Pages env vars are set.
register.failureHandling: Repair and rerun before delivery or push.
register.removalConditions: Only after equal or stronger replacement proof is admitted.
